corrections.text: The article quotes 9to5Google as saying "No Creative Cloud subscription is required, advertisements are absent, and there are no watermarks." The source's actual wording is: "You don't need a Creative Cloud subscription, you don't need to sit through ads, and there are no watermarks either." The claim is accurate; the quotation was a paraphrase, not verbatim.

The article quotes 9to5Google describing the app as "the same application that debuted on iPhones in late 2025." The source actually says "the same app that debuted on iPhone in late 2025" (singular "app"/"iPhone"). The claim is accurate; the quotation was paraphrased.

The article quotes 9to5Google saying the Android app arrived "months after its iPhone debut." The source's sentence reads "Months after it arrived on iPhone, Adobe Premiere's mobile version is now available on Android devices..." The underlying claim is accurate; the quotation was a paraphrase rather than an exact excerpt.
